notes.title: Game Over Odyssey Announced
notes.notes:
Hey all,

Just thought I'd post here about the next project from White Sparkle Games for anyone interested.

[b]Game Over Odssey[/b] is a turn-based RPG set in an alternate universe where games loosely based on our own exist. Gameplay-wise, it's a spiritual sequel to Paper Mario: TTYD.

[h1]Key features:[/h1]

[list]
[*]7 chapters based on different video game genres such as platformer, SHMUP, arcade, puzzle, and JRPG. 

[*]Simple but tactically deep turn-based combat. Use items, curios, boons, and battlefield spaces to gain advantage over opponents.

[*]Customize your playstyle by leveling 6 unique stats per party member. Do you want a dedicated item user/enhancer or a formidable, 5 HP technique spammer? You make the call.

[*]Gameplay modes and unique per-chapter content that encourage multiple playthroughs.
[/list]

A playable demo containing the game's complete prologue and first chapter will be available later this year. For now, here's some screenshots.

notes.title: Blink the Bulb - Version 1.01
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch notes for Blink the Bulb version 1.01[/h1]

[b]Features/tweaks:[/b]

*Added Steam achievements

*Slightly increased the damage Blink's double jump deals to enemies on contact

*Increased shield duration for Lamppost Head active item

*Increased zombie life duration for Brain Food passive item

*Zombies spawned from Brain Food passive item will now destroy most physical/spike damage type projectiles on contact

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

*Fixed a bug with the Cupid Arrow passive that could crash the game if it incorrectly tried to home in on a defeated enemy

*Fixed a bug in Love Land 1 where the player could clip through a one-way floor

*Added a missing tile graphic in Winter Land 2

*Fixed a visual bug that prevented Egg Land 1's daytime miniboss from entering its defeat pose

Version 1.02 of the game will feature an option to use the keyboard when a gamepad is detected. If you have any other features you'd like to see feel free to ask.
